display.purpose: Page titles; 1.2 modular scale from 1rem base (fs-4 = 2.488rem).

heading.purpose: Section and card titles; headings name their own ink (gray-900 light / #d8e2ef dark).

body.purpose: Prose and form text at 1rem, gray-700 (8.9:1 on white).

label.purpose: Tables, badges, tabs, nav links, metadata at 0.833rem — the workhorse size of data surfaces (The On-Scale Rule).

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default card float; tint-neutralized, never blue-cast.

shadows.name: btn-orkestra
shadows.purpose: The ring-plus-drop that makes white falcon/orkestra buttons read as raised keys.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The 0.25rem :focus-visible ring ($btn-focus-width, both-modes 2026-08-07). No call site may suppress it with shadow-none on a focusable control.

components.description: Solid Orkestra Blue — the single main action of a view.

components.name: Orkestra (Falcon) Button
components.description: The signature white raised-key button for secondary and toolbar actions (variant="falcon-primary").

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface floating on the gray-200 canvas with the ambient shadow.
components.html:
Active sessions
One card level, one shadow level — depth beyond this comes from tone, not elevation.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 0.375rem; box-shadow: 0 7px 14px 0 rgba(50, 58, 70, 0.1), 0 3px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--orkestra-gray-900, #252c36); padding: 1rem 1.25rem; background: var(--orkestra-gray-100, #f9fafb); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--orkestra-gray-300, #dfe3e8); } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--orkestra-gray-700, #454c58); padding: 1.25rem; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: AdvanceTable look: gray-300 header band on th, fs-10 striped rows, 8px vertical density. Pagination buttons are always tertiary — wayfinding, never the page's call to action (2026-08-07).
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.833rem; color: var(--orkestra-gray-700, #454c58); } .ds-table th { background: var(--orkestra-table-head-bg, #dfe3e8); color: var(--orkestra-gray-900, #252c36); font-weight: 600; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-table td { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--orkestra-gray-300, #dfe3e8); } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--orkestra-gray-100, #f9fafb); } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--orkestra-gray-200, #f2f4f6); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White field, gray-600 border (controls owe 3:1), blue focus ring — default-size forms stay at body size, size="sm" forms drop to fs-10. Invalid fields carry aria-invalid plus a danger border and feedback text.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 0.833rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--orkestra-gray-900, #252c36); margin-bottom: 0.375rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--orkestra-gray-700, #454c58); background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--orkestra-gray-600, #68707c); border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 0.3125rem 0.75rem; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--orkestra-gray-600, #68707c); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--orkestra-primary, #2c7be5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(44, 123, 229, 0.25); }

The corner ribbon is the console's one expressive flourish, reserved for real attention states.

narrative.overview: A calm operations floor. Surfaces are quiet, neutral grays — a near-white canvas carrying white cards — and every signal on them is legible at a glance: body text holds an 8.9:1 contrast on white, headings are near-black, and color appears only where something acts or needs attention. The system's personality is calm, clinical, precise: the interface recedes so the operator's data comes forward. Nothing decorates; everything either informs or acts. The confirmed anti-reference is the console's own past: Falcon's blue-tinted gray ramp (lavender page background #edf2f9, washed-out slate text #5e6e82). The 2026-08 retune replaced it with a neutral-cool scale — a whisper of cool tint in the GitHub-light register, chosen against a Datadog-inspired reference — and that neutrality is now an invariant, not a phase.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral-cool "Cool Graphite" gray ramp; never blue-cast, never fully achromatic.
High contrast as a feature: 8.9:1 body text, headings at gray-900.
Color is semantic — Orkestra Blue means "you can act here"; status colors mean status.
Operate-mode density: compact tables (fs-10, 8px vertical cell padding), information-first layouts.
Ambient, discreet elevation: soft shadows separate, tonal layers structure.
A permanently frozen dark theme, pixel-identical since 2026-08-05 apart from changes explicitly declared both-modes (see the Frozen Dark Rule).

rules.name: The Frozen Dark Rule
rules.body: The dark theme is pixel-frozen and permanently decoupled from the light ramp. Never derive a dark value from $gray-* or the light tokens; dark values are literals (see _variables-dark.scss, root/_dark.scss, and the freeze notes). Any future light retune must freeze its dark twins the same way. Dark moves only for a change declared both-modes; on 2026-08-07 that was $body-secondary-color-dark (#d8e2ef → #8494a8, the de-emphasis fix) and $headings-color-dark, pinned to the literal it already resolved to. Both are hand-picked literals, not derivations.

rules.name: The Secondary-Is-Secondary Rule
rules.body: --orkestra-secondary-color — which .text-muted reads — must sit below body text, never above. It held gray-900 until 2026-08-07 and so rendered every de-emphasized string (field help, group descriptions, StatCard captions, muted table cells) at 14.07:1 against a body of 8.65:1: the whole de-emphasis layer ran backwards. Headings now name their own ink (gray-900 / #d8e2ef), leaving secondary free to be secondary: gray-600 (5.00:1 on a card, 4.54:1 on the canvas) and #8494a8 in dark (5.43:1). De-emphasize with ink or with size, weight and case — but never invert the ramp to do it.

rules.name: The Acting Blue Rule
rules.body: Orkestra Blue appears only where the operator can act or is acting (buttons, links, active/selected/focused states). Large decorative washes of primary are off-system.

rules.name: The Utility-Class Rule
rules.body: Components never carry hex values. Color reaches JSX through Bootstrap/theme utilities (text-900, bg-200, border-300, text-body-tertiary) or CSS variables (--orkestra-*); charts read live values via getColor(). This is what keeps both themes and future retunes one-file changes.

rules.name: The fs-10 Table Rule
rules.body: Data tables run at fs-10 (0.833rem): density is a feature of the Control Room, not a compromise. Don't bump table type up to body size to "improve readability" — contrast, not size, does that job here.

rules.name: The On-Scale Rule
rules.body: Every size on screen is a step of $font-sizes — there is no 14px and no 12px in this console. Bootstrap's own defaults are the usual leak ($font-size-sm 0.875rem behind size="sm" controls, $small-font-size 75% behind .form-text, and .nav-link's --orkestra-nav-link-font-size, declared but never defined outside the pill/tab variants, so a bare Nav silently inherits 1rem). Fix those at the token or component-SCSS level so the whole console moves together; adding an fs-* class at the call site patches one page and hides the leak everywhere else.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Don't invent intermediate shadow tiers or "lift" elements for emphasis. If something needs more weight, use tone (gray-100 fill, gray-300 border) or type, not a bigger shadow.

rules.name: The Legible-Selection Rule
rules.body: Active-item ink is --orkestra-primary-text-emphasis, not raw Orkestra Blue: blue on blue-subtle measures 3.30:1 light / 3.42:1 dark against inactive siblings at 8.65:1 / 7.06:1 — the selected item ends up the hardest thing in its own list to read. The emphasis token is theme-aware and lands 5.25:1 / 8.44:1. Selection also carries a non-chromatic mark — the module config rail a 3px inset left bar, the tab bar a 2px underline — so it survives greyscale and low vision. Fills, focus rings and hovers stay Orkestra Blue; only the label of a selected item takes the emphasis ink.

dos: Do reach color through utilities and --orkestra-* variables — text-900, bg-200, border-300 — and through getColor() in charts.
Do keep tables dense: fs-10, 0.5rem vertical padding, gray-300 header band, striped gray-100 rows.
Do use the falcon/orkestra white-shadowed button family for secondary actions and keep solid Orkestra Blue for the single primary action of a view.
Do verify every change in both themes; dark must remain pixel-identical unless a change is explicitly declared both-modes (like the 2026-08 density change).
Do meet WCAG 2.2 AA: the ramp's contrast ratios (8.9:1 body, 5.4:1 secondary) are the floor, not the ceiling; focus states visible; target sizes respected.
donts: Don't derive dark-theme values from the light ramp — dark is frozen literals, permanently (The Frozen Dark Rule).
Don't reintroduce blue-tinted grays, tinted shadows, or the old Falcon values (#edf2f9, #5e6e82, rgba(65,69,88,…)) anywhere in light mode.
Don't hardcode hex colors, inline color/spacing styles, or generic fonts in components — the theme provides all three.
Don't build bespoke primitives where one exists: no raw <table> (AdvanceTable), no hand-rolled KPI tiles (StatCard), no solid status badges (SubtleBadge), no Chart.js/D3 (ECharts via ReactEchart).

Don't use Orkestra Blue decoratively or add new saturated hues to the system — the palette is closed: one action color (with its darker Link Ink), four status colors, graphite, and the single utilitarian code accent (#c22e64, AA on white).
